name: Neuhaus (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neuhaus (a red lion with a key on white above a white tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Neuhaus; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neuhaus arms — lion with key and tower
